purpose: Teach: 美学/うかがい/異物/恥ずかしながら/相まって/のけ/汚し/勝た

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、捜査には美学があるとお考えなさいませ
lines.en: Police work has its own ethics, I believe.
lines.style: Measured and formal. Opens with quiet authority. Speaks as though sharing a principle, not lecturing. Steady rhythm, each phrase deliberate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、市民のお声をうかがい、ご対応されてありがたいです
lines.en: Yes. We're grateful that the police listen to the community and respond with care.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. Not deferential — earnest. Slight warmth under the formality, like he means every word. Steady pace.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、押収品から異物が出てきた事件があります
lines.en: There was an incident where a foreign object turned up in seized evidence.
lines.style: Professional, matter-of-fact. States the fact plainly without emotion. Clean delivery, no apology in the tone — just the information.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 恥ずかしながら、警察も連絡ミスがありました
lines.en: I must admit, we made communication errors on our end as well.
lines.style: Honest, slightly weighted. Not defensive — owning the mistake with quiet dignity. Slight pause before the final clause, like taking responsibility deliberately.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 地域の声と警察の努力が相まっての解決ですね
lines.en: It was the community's voice and the police's effort working together that solved this.
lines.style: Warm recognition. Speaks with genuine respect for partnership. Not flattering — observing something real. Slight nod in the rhythm.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、誰一人のけ者にしない地域づくりに協力します
lines.en: The police are committed to building a community where no one is left behind.
lines.style: Formal but felt. Speaks like a pledge, not a slogan. Steady and clear. Weight on 'committed' — this is a real undertaking.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域の名を汚した事件、警察、断固対応ありがたいです
lines.en: Yes. Thank you for your firm response to the crime that damaged our community's trust.
lines.style: Respectful gratitude. Acknowledges both the hurt and the remedy. Earnest without being effusive. Slight heaviness on 'damaged,' then relief on 'firm response.'

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪に勝たねば市民は安心できません
lines.en: Unless we defeat crime, the community can't truly feel safe.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Speaks like someone who has thought about this deeply. Not dramatic — just clear and final. Slight pause before the last clause.
